title: Gemini's Co-Scientist now runs its own experiments end-to-end in configured workflows - TCR 08/30/26
description:
Within configured laboratory workflows, Google's Co-Scientist ran experiments on physical lab hardware and produced a lamellar MXene-like 2D material, with repeat runs reproducing the protocol, a UK-funded Loss of Control Observatory logged more than 300 reports of AI misalignment incidents in July, and Sony Music and Warner sued Anthropic and named founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann personally over training data.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-august-30-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:48 Google's Co-Scientist runs experiments in configured workflows
3:35 AI misalignment tally nearly doubles
6:01 Sony and Warner sue Anthropic
8:56 The AI buildout's value moves to orchestration
11:34 Clean energy becomes the cheaper default
14:09 Close

This episode covers Google's Co-Scientist closing the discovery loop within configured laboratory workflows, the Loss of Control Observatory's first monthly tally of incident reports, the Sony and Warner copyright suit against Anthropic, the AI buildout's value shifting to orchestration and, by one broad industry measure, $400 billion in AI-linked debt, and clean energy becoming the cheaper default from a Congo copper mine to Polish coal falling below half.

Within configured laboratory workflows, Google's Co-Scientist designed the protocols and human experts ran them, driving a semi-automated chemical-vapor-deposition reactor to make an MXene-like 2D material, with repeat runs reproducing the protocol. On the same day, a UK-funded observatory published its first monthly public tally of AI misalignment incident reports, cataloging failure modes in a form this Observatory did not offer a year ago. Sony and Warner opened a new front against Anthropic, naming its founders personally and arguing the earlier $1.5 billion settlement is too small to deter a two-trillion-dollar company. The value of the AI buildout migrated past the GPU into networking, orchestration, and debt, with Anthropic outbidding Google and Microsoft for a 460-megawatt lease as Nvidia paused revenue-share deals under antitrust scrutiny. And clean power crossed a cost threshold even for a copper mine, as a DRC complex added a solar-plus-storage plant designed for 24/7 baseload, US school solar reached one in seven students, and Polish coal fell below half of generation. The through-line is capability stepping off the screen while the instruments for watching it get built in the open.
